evidence_spans.snippet: The first byte contains the device address (0x52) and also specifies the data direction.
The minimum range measurement period is 8 ms.
Single ranging Ranging is performed only once after the API function is called.
Continuous ranging. Ranging is performed in a continuous way after the API function is called.
Timed ranging. Ranging is performed in a continuous way after the API function is called.
The user can get the final data using a polling or an interrupt mechanism.
An interrupt pin (GPIO1) sends an interrupt to the host when a new measurement is available.
